notes_for_editor: The build date is unresolved. The register says the CCC built it in 1938; the Camden News items reproduced on Central US Lookouts (Feb to March 1935) describe the state forestry commission planning and starting a steel tower near Chidester. The 1935 items describe plans, not a finished tower, and no source read reconciles them with 1938. The radio relay use and the 1985 end of service come only from the register page, with no second source. The 1941 survey places the tower about 8 miles north of Camden, while the 1935 notices put Chidester 16 miles west of Camden; these differences were not resolved and the story avoids both distances. An Encyclopedia of Arkansas photo caption (Poison Spring State Park) was seen only in search results and not used. No access information was found, so access is not set.
